services.desc: starringLisa Akey & Rachel Robinson as "Lulu"Gloria Dorson & Angela Paton as "Meg"Ralph Drischell & Robert Symonds as "Petey"Morlan Higgins & Gregory Itzin as "McCann"Jay Karnes & Raphael Sbarge as "Stanley"Lawrence Pressman & Armin Shimerman as "Goldberg" Poor Stanley. He's wasting away in a rundown boarding-house, virtually a recluse, yet two menacing men have come to cart him away-on the day that his landlady insists is his birthday. It's party time. "The Birthday Party" was the first of Harold Pinter's plays to be produced in London. Now, more than 40 years later, this vintage Pinter retains its theatrical charge in a Matrix Theatre production.
